description: Three test failures, each an independent test-helper bug, but bundled under INC-002 because they share the same root-cause class (test fixture pre-dates migrations 1144/1145 schema additions): (A) TC-PRM-06-03 — `insertPromotionReviewsRow` does not set the `requested_by` NOT NULL column added by migration 1144 → sqlstate 23502. (B) TC-PRM-07-03 — `insertPromotionAssertionRunsRow` (or sibling) inserts into `promotion_assertion_runs` without first seeding a parent `promotion_reviews` row → sqlstate 23503. (C) TC-PRM-07-01 — sandbox teardown failure simulation marker does not propagate into the post-condition `promotion_assertion_runs.status` setter. Pre-existing, NOT GH-785 regressions; out of scope for WF03-GH785-20260815. To be picked up by its own WF-03 cycle.
